settings.title: Connection Settings
settings.baseUrlPlaceholder: Empty = same origin (zero-config when served at /ui)
settings.baseUrlHint: For development use http://127.0.0.1:8742; the page reloads after saving.
settings.adminTokenHint: The admin side stores only this token's SHA-256 (BOT_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN_SHA256); paste the plaintext value here. Data endpoints are readable.
settings.roTokenHint: Optional fallback; used when the primary token is absent.
settings.tokenPlaceholder: Paste token (stored locally in this browser only)
settings.tokenSavedPlaceholder: Saved (leave blank to keep, type to replace)
settings.note: The control plane has no login endpoint: paste the admin-issued token here; it is kept only in this browser's localStorage and sent exclusively via the Authorization header, never in URLs. Without a token, data endpoints answer 503 control_plane_not_provisioned.

state.notProvisioned: Control plane has no access token configured
state.notProvisionedHint: The server requires a Bearer token (anti-bare-metric protection). Paste the admin-issued token in Settings and retry.
state.authFailedHint: Check that the token is correct and still valid, then update it in Settings.

reason.audit_source_not_configured: Audit DB path not configured (bot_audit_db_path empty)
reason.missing_source: Database file missing (no data yet or path not pointing at runtime dir)
reason.query_budget_exceeded: Query exceeded its time budget (dataset too large)
reason.not_connected: Data source not wired into the control plane
reason.not_persisted: This data has no persistent storage
reason.collection_not_available: Collection not enabled (no dedicated store in this project)
reason.all_sources_missing: All data sources missing (DB files absent or paths unconfigured)
reason.static_config_unavailable: Static declaration unavailable (manifest missing or section absent)
reason.cross_process_introspection_unavailable: The runtime registry lives inside the bot host process; the control plane has no cross-process introspection channel
reason.unreadable: Source exists but read failed (schema mismatch)

overview.queue: Send queue depth — no read-only endpoint yet
overview.alerts: Active alerts — no read-only endpoint yet
overview.aboutDesc: Every card is assembled from live read-only endpoints; missing sources honestly show “no data”
overview.aboutBody: Sources: calls=audit_records, LLM=llm_call_records ledger, channels=channel_health in-memory store, affinity=user_affinity read-only DB.
overview.callsDetailDesc: The 24h and 7d windows are fetched independently (never merged across windows); “last message” is the newest audit time within the window — shown as — when there is no record
overview.activeUsersHint: Distinct attributable users within the window; sessions outside the OneBot convention are never counted as users

calls.title: Call Stats
calls.unknownHint: Rows whose created_at cannot be parsed are excluded from every window (backend never guesses time)
calls.unattributedHint: Session ids not matching the OneBot convention (private_<uid>/group_<gid>_<uid>) are never presented as users
calls.trendDesc: {{bucket}} buckets · {{timezone}} · stored newest-first, reversed for display
calls.sessionPseudonym: Session ids are HMAC-pseudonymised; raw ids are never echoed

attribution.onebot: Users derived from the OneBot session convention

tokens.title: Token Panel
tokens.stackDesc: Stack = uncached input / cache read / cache creation / output (cache tokens are a subset of input, so they are split out rather than added)
tokens.qualityHint: ?N = N rows in the family reported nothing for this series; ~N = partial. Only attested values are counted — never estimated

latency.title: Channel Latency
latency.source: channel_health in-memory store, current values · refreshes every 30s
latency.historyUnavailable: Explicitly unavailable upstream ({{reason}}) — nothing persisted, no fake curve drawn

affinity.title: Affinity Board
affinity.boardDesc: user_affinity read-only snapshot · explicit numeric display (chat-side wording stays qualitative)

logs.title: Log Tail
logs.gapBanner: Cursor fell outside the retention window; there is a gap: {{message}} (the backend forbids silently resetting cursors client-side)
logs.playbackHint: Connecting replays the current retention window, then follows live
logs.idle: Disconnected. Press “Connect” to start tailing (replays retention window).
logs.transportNote: Transport: streamed fetch (EventSource cannot send Authorization headers); exponential-backoff reconnects resume via Last-Event-ID; tokens travel in headers only, never in URLs.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: Read-only catalog of community terms, the vector knowledge base and meme tags; the panel never writes, enabling/writing is configured bot-side
knowledge.emptyCollection: No entries in this collection yet
knowledge.notDeployedHint: The running control-plane instance does not provide /api/v1/knowledge/* (older process); available after the control plane restarts with the new routes.
knowledge.allDisabledHint: Enable any knowledge source in the bot configuration (glossary / vector KB / meme library / ACG search) and restart; collections will appear here.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Read-only catalog of builtins, adapters, event matchers and migrated domains; entries marked “restart” require a bot restart to take effect
plugins.notDeployedHint: The running control-plane instance does not provide /api/v1/plugins (older process); available after the control plane restarts with the new routes.

memoryGraph.title: Memory Graph
memoryGraph.subtitle: Read-only association view over chat history, long-term memory and learned rules; edges are an identity map and never modify memory
memoryGraph.truncated: Node set truncated: showing the {{count}} most connected of {{total}} nodes
memoryGraph.empty: No memory associations in this window
memoryGraph.canvasHint: Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · Click a node for details; edges are a read-only identity map and never modify memory
memoryGraph.dataScopeBody: Window {{window}}. Conversation/speaking edges come from the chat-history DB; memory edges from the long-term memory DB (person attribution); rules from active quirks and learned nicknames; affinity weights are current-state and do not vary with the window.
memoryGraph.partialTitle: Some data sources are not counted; this graph and its stats are partial
memoryGraph.notDeployedHint: The running control-plane instance does not provide /api/v1/memory/graph (older process); available after the control plane restarts with the new routes.
